structuredContent.body:
## Why

The HCSN research claims need a reproducible chain to the actual source, model, data, configuration and raw execution records. Earlier evidence gaps, unsuccessful trials and publication failures must remain inspectable.

## What this changes

This is a mechanical archival change on top of #5803. It adds the frozen 2026-11-10 P0–P5 evidence package: 472 manifest-bound files, exact runtime/source capsules, numerical successes and failures, baseline36 plus C1 independent reviews, a finite QVI fixture, generated non-diffusion controls, and a 55-row cost ledger with explicit overlapping scopes.

The snapshot records the original six HCSN fits as last observed at 18:01 UTC and was curated at 18:36 UTC. Their later budget-exhausted terminal records and subsequent checkpoint numerical review belong to a separate append-only package. This PR does not retrospectively rewrite that observation.

Large model/log archives are held in an unpublished draft release with authenticated byte verification; incomplete asset attempts are explicitly retained. CURRENT and the prospective research protocol are separate reviewable changes. The prospective single-clock fix in #5821 is not substituted for native C1 source.

## Validation and scope

- Independent snapshot review: 472 file size/SHA256 bindings, 38 archive instances, 182 relative links, 55 cost references and 245 explicit data bindings verified.
- Repository evidence checker: all three historical/current manifests and four Markdown entry points passed, covering 659 file entries with no errors.
- Baseline36+C1: 33/36 attempts meet the declared training heuristic after continuation; three memorization failures remain. This is not a completed or sufficiently trained HCSN comparison.
- Existing hosted science fixtures passed on their recorded source tree; repository-wide CI, full training-domain numerical accuracy, scientific benefit, GPU/energy efficiency and production admission remain separately gated.

Exact local tree: `5290969fac4c50f6c9663ff32124c734873490a8`.
The GitHub API mirror was verified to have the identical entire tree before advancing this branch. No main-branch merge or release publication is requested.
